title: Portfolio-app
description: A modern Next.js portfolio with a built-in CMS, Markdown support, and a secure contact system
details:
This project is a professional, full-stack portfolio application designed to showcase development skills and projects with a focus on speed and clean design.

Key Features:

Dynamic Project Management: Includes a hidden, password-protected administrative panel (CMS) that allows the user to create, update, and delete projects directly through the UI.

Markdown Support: Each project detail page renders full Markdown content, enabling rich text descriptions, code blocks, and formatted lists for project case studies.

Optimized Image Handling: Integrated with Vercel Blob storage, the application supports direct image uploads for project thumbnails and previews with real-time previewing during the upload process.

Contact System: A fully functional contact form powered by the Resend API, featuring server-side validation and automated email delivery to stay in touch with potential clients or collaborators.

Performance and SEO: Built using Next.js 16 with server-side rendering (SSR) and static site generation (SSG) principles, ensuring fast load times and search engine visibility.

Modern UI/UX: Styled with Tailwind CSS for a fully responsive, mobile-first experience featuring a clean, professional aesthetic.
